title: Draconia faction creature roster
implementationBoundary: Original named design catalogue. No numerical balance, models, animations, recruitment or new action behavior is implied. Existing legacy keys are not silently migrated to these IDs. Every family and promotion must pass rules, content, UI and native animation gates.

families.name: Hearthguard
families.battlefieldRole: Affordable spear-and-shield line; protects a chosen approach.
families.silhouette: Adult militia in quilted coats, open helmets and broad wooden shields.
families.counter: Flank the brace or force movement with a visible hazard.
families.watchRule: No innate phase bonus; formation readiness is retained through a prepared watch.

promotions.name: Oathguard
promotions.mechanic: A stationary front shares a finite brace against one incoming charge.
promotions.tradeoff: Slower turning and longer reform after moving.

promotions.name: Marchguard
promotions.mechanic: Can reform a shorter brace quickly after a legal advance.
promotions.tradeoff: Less frontal absorption than Oathguard; cannot charge while braced.

families.name: Briarbow Hunters
families.battlefieldRole: Bow pressure from a protected firing lane.
families.silhouette: Wool-clad adult hunters with plain longbows and visible quivers.
families.counter: Close the distance or use hard cover; arrows require clear lanes.
families.watchRule: Night sight follows normal observation; no shooting at unseen actors.

promotions.name: Longwatch Archers
promotions.mechanic: A prepared stationary aim extends a straight accurate firing lane.
promotions.tradeoff: Longer setup and exposed recovery when repositioning.

promotions.name: Harrowshot Skirmishers
promotions.mechanic: Loose a shorter-range spread while making a small controlled reposition.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower single-target force and less reach.

families.name: Redmane Riders
families.battlefieldRole: Mounted flank pressure with a readable committed charge.
families.silhouette: Practical armored riders on red-brown horses, lances above the line.
families.counter: A braced spear front stops the charge; tight turns cost momentum.
families.watchRule: No supernatural phase rule; road knowledge is strategic, not hidden night damage.

promotions.name: Dawnlances
promotions.mechanic: A long clear approach concentrates the charge into a narrow first impact.
promotions.tradeoff: Poor turning and long recovery after a failed charge.

promotions.name: Roadward Cavaliers
promotions.mechanic: Shorter controlled charges can peel threats off an escorted ally.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower burst and no long-lane impact bonus.

families.name: Bellwardens
families.battlefieldRole: Close support that protects morale and interrupts a harmful condition.
families.silhouette: Adult robed custodians with small handbells, staff and medicine satchels.
families.counter: Pressure or interrupt the visible support channel.
families.watchRule: A night vigil helps identify a nearby active curse source, not hidden armies.

promotions.name: Cleansing Cantors
promotions.mechanic: Remove one eligible hostile status with a targeted channeled chant.
promotions.tradeoff: Give up the larger morale response; no reward on an unaffected target.

promotions.name: Rallying Wardens
promotions.mechanic: A completed bell cadence steadies a bounded nearby group of shaken allies.
promotions.tradeoff: Cannot cleanse poison or revive casualties.

families.name: Oathhounds
families.battlefieldRole: Fast domestic trackers that expose a recently encountered hidden threat.
families.silhouette: Large shaggy working dogs with fitted leather harnesses and no armor plates.
families.counter: Durable fronts and area denial punish their small unprotected bodies.
families.watchRule: Night tracking follows only a recent local scent; it does not reveal unexplored rooms.

promotions.name: Trailhounds
promotions.mechanic: Maintain a short trace of a wounded target after it leaves ordinary sight.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower interception durability; trace expires and stops at sealed transitions.

promotions.name: Gatehounds
promotions.mechanic: Briefly intercept a hostile rushing within an assigned protection radius.
promotions.tradeoff: Short pursuit leash and less tracking reach.

families.name: Dawncrest Griffins
families.battlefieldRole: Rare winged shock creatures that threaten a flank.
families.silhouette: Lion-sized quadrupeds with feathered forequarters, powerful wings and readable landing tells.
families.counter: Prepared ranged lanes and a braced landing zone punish their commitment.
families.watchRule: Dusk changes presentation only; flight is a declared altitude rule, not phase invulnerability.

promotions.name: Stormcrest Griffins
promotions.mechanic: Intercept an airborne target through a visible climb and swoop.
promotions.tradeoff: Longer grounded recovery and weaker attacks against a sheltered line.

promotions.name: Ironcrest Griffins
promotions.mechanic: Commit to a heavy ground dive that displaces a small frontage.
promotions.tradeoff: Reduced airborne agility; a missed dive leaves a wide punish window.

families.name: Thornlings
families.battlefieldRole: Light living-wood line that binds a small frontage.
families.silhouette: Knee-to-chest-high twig-and-root beings with distinct hands and grounded root feet.
families.counter: Fire and repeated displacement break their preferred anchored front.
families.watchRule: Rooting at dusk changes only an announced readiness action; no passive health refill.

promotions.name: Rootward Thornlings
promotions.mechanic: Plant into a narrow defensive brace that resists displacement.
promotions.tradeoff: Must uproot before moving and lose the brace during that transition.

promotions.name: Brushward Thornlings
promotions.mechanic: Move through traversable brush quickly and leave a short slowing trail.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower frontal resilience; solid roots and walls still block.

families.name: Briarwitches
families.battlefieldRole: Ranged seed and bramble pressure with deliberate cast preparation.
families.silhouette: Adult hedge practitioners in layered cloth, thorn staffs and seed gourds.
families.counter: Interrupt the cast or move out of the marked patch before it grows.
families.watchRule: Night does not remove the visible growth warning.

promotions.name: Briarweavers
promotions.mechanic: Turn a small prepared patch into an interruptible movement bind.
promotions.tradeoff: Less direct damage and a longer preparation window.

promotions.name: Briarspikers
promotions.mechanic: Concentrate thorns into an aimed projectile that exposes an unguarded target.
promotions.tradeoff: No persistent binding zone; shields and hard cover stop the shot.

families.name: Hollowstags
families.battlefieldRole: Fast antlered flankers that use forest circulation.
families.silhouette: Large hollow-marked deer with bark-like antlers and visible hoof contact.
families.counter: Spears and narrow blocked approaches stop their preferred angle.
families.watchRule: At dusk a visible antler signal can announce their first reposition; it grants no free strike.

promotions.name: Miststags
promotions.mechanic: Make one short veiled reposition through legal soft terrain before reappearing.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower impact; cannot pass a sealed wall or remain untargetable while attacking.

promotions.name: Crownstags
promotions.mechanic: A straight antler charge briefly displaces light units.
promotions.tradeoff: Longer recovery and worse turning than Miststags.

families.name: Veilkin Envoys
families.battlefieldRole: Wingless spirit support built around rhythm and directed distraction.
families.silhouette: Adult humanoid spirits in muted flowing garments, grounded dance steps and no wings.
families.counter: Break the formation rhythm by interrupting or leaving its marked area.
families.watchRule: Dusk/night permits one additional visible rhythm beat; duration remains capped.

promotions.name: Veildancers
promotions.mechanic: A completed marked sequence briefly distracts eligible light enemies from an uncommitted action.
promotions.tradeoff: No effect on committed attacks or resolved bosses; weaker ally protection.

promotions.name: Veilsingers
promotions.mechanic: Maintain a small finite protective refrain on allies who remain in the circle.
promotions.tradeoff: Stationary channel and no hostile distraction.

families.name: Mosswardens
families.battlefieldRole: Slow living-wood specialists that anchor an objective.
families.silhouette: Broad walking trunks with moss, root legs and a visible vulnerable heart hollow.
families.counter: Force them to move, flank the heart opening or use fire with care for nearby allies.
families.watchRule: A resting night state is presentation; recovery still consumes a declared rule action.

promotions.name: Rootbound Wardens
promotions.mechanic: Anchor a broad root barrier that protects a small rear arc.
promotions.tradeoff: Immobile while active and vulnerable around the ends.

promotions.name: Sporewardens
promotions.mechanic: Release a bounded spore cloud that weakens living attackers crossing it.
promotions.tradeoff: No physical barrier; bloodless enemies resist the biological effect.

families.name: Duskwood Wyrms
families.battlefieldRole: Large forest serpents that shape approach lanes.
families.silhouette: Long scaled bodies, leaf-like dorsal growth and a clearly planted head before breath.
families.counter: Spread around their committed head direction and punish the recovery.
families.watchRule: Twilight allows a visible camouflage preparation; an attack breaks it.

promotions.name: Bramblewyrms
promotions.mechanic: Project a short bramble corridor that limits pursuit.
promotions.tradeoff: Shorter reach and no broad mist protection.

promotions.name: Moonleaf Wyrms
promotions.mechanic: Breathe a cooling mist that weakens distant aim across a declared zone.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower direct damage; mist also affects allied shots through it.

families.name: Galeguard
families.battlefieldRole: Mountain-trained front line that protects channels.
families.silhouette: Adult guards with short polearms, kite shields and restrained blue-gray cloaks.
families.counter: Displace them before their protection forms or attack the unshielded flank.
families.watchRule: No free night bonus; protection depends on a prepared stance.

promotions.name: Skyward Guard
promotions.mechanic: Angle a finite shield screen against incoming projectiles from one side.
promotions.tradeoff: Less melee brace and slower movement while raised.

promotions.name: Passward Guard
promotions.mechanic: Lock a narrow approach against light displacement and charges.
promotions.tradeoff: No broad projectile screen; vulnerable to a second approach.

families.name: Rookcallers
families.battlefieldRole: Ranged handlers who mark a target with a bounded corvid attack.
families.silhouette: Adult keepers with gloved arms, short staves and a small real bird flock.
families.counter: Shelter behind hard cover or interrupt the handler; birds are limited actors.
families.watchRule: Night birds follow marked visible targets; they do not reveal the whole battlefield.

promotions.name: Stormrook Keepers
promotions.mechanic: A prepared marked strike carries one bounded shock between nearby enemies.
promotions.tradeoff: Longer recall/cooldown and reduced pressure on isolated targets.

promotions.name: Rimewing Keepers
promotions.mechanic: A bird pass chills one moving target and reveals its brief trail.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower burst and no chain effect.

families.name: Windstriders
families.battlefieldRole: Light human skirmishers with a deliberate wind-assisted reposition.
families.silhouette: Lean adult travelers in fitted climbing gear and short asymmetric mantle cloth.
families.counter: Pressure the landing and force a move before their escape is ready.
families.watchRule: At night the landing mark remains visible; darkness never hides the legal destination.

promotions.name: Guststriders
promotions.mechanic: Redirect once during a short legal ground dash.
promotions.tradeoff: Less attack force and a longer escape cooldown.

promotions.name: Stormrunners
promotions.mechanic: Turn a straight committed dash into a stronger arrival strike.
promotions.tradeoff: Cannot redirect after commitment and has exposed recovery on a miss.

families.name: Tempest Sages
families.battlefieldRole: Weather casters who prepare useful zones rather than constant instant damage.
families.silhouette: Adult mountain scholars with rain-dark robes, staffs and copper instruments.
families.counter: Interrupt preparation, separate targets or leave the announced zone.
families.watchRule: A night ritual uses the same warning and cost; no hidden instant lightning.

promotions.name: Rainbinders
promotions.mechanic: Create a wet support zone that suppresses ordinary fire and prepares storm interactions.
promotions.tradeoff: Little direct burst and can assist an enemy that benefits from water.

promotions.name: Thunderbinders
promotions.mechanic: Channel a bounded lightning sequence through a prepared lane.
promotions.tradeoff: Long commitment; scattered targets reduce its value.

families.name: Cloudhorn Beasts
families.battlefieldRole: Massive mountain rams that break or shelter a narrow line.
families.silhouette: Heavy shaggy caprines with broad horns, low stance and stable hoof placement.
families.counter: Make the ram turn or meet it with a braced line rather than its charge.
families.watchRule: Cold-night comfort removes only a declared terrain penalty; no immunity to frost damage.

promotions.name: Copperhorn Rams
promotions.mechanic: A committed horn impact cracks an armored guard or finite ward.
promotions.tradeoff: Weaker escort protection and long recovery against an empty lane.

promotions.name: Snowhorn Keepers
promotions.mechanic: Hold a protective shoulder position beside a named ally or channel.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower charge damage and short pursuit distance.

families.name: Crownwyrms
families.battlefieldRole: Prestigious winged storm creatures with directional breath.
families.silhouette: Large crowned reptiles with broad wings, four grounded limbs and clear breath posture.
families.counter: Exploit the breath tell, spread targets and punish a grounded recovery.
families.watchRule: Storm/night conditions are announced in context; a breath is never untelegraphed.

promotions.name: Thunder Crownwyrms
promotions.mechanic: Release a narrow conductive breath that rewards aligned wet targets.
promotions.tradeoff: Less control over a broad area and a longer charge-up.

promotions.name: Rain Crownwyrms
promotions.mechanic: Create a wide temporary rain front that changes fire and ranged interactions.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower direct killing power; the water state can help either side.

families.name: Gravewights
families.battlefieldRole: Enduring revenant infantry with an inspectable binding condition.
families.silhouette: Armored adult dead with worn cloth, restrained pallor and deliberate footfalls.
families.counter: Separate them from the declared binding support and attack their slow turns.
families.watchRule: Night strengthens binding readiness; daylight removes that benefit without deleting the unit.

promotions.name: Oathwights
promotions.mechanic: Protect a nearby registered binding source with a finite shared defense.
promotions.tradeoff: Reduced offensive pursuit and weaker outside the source radius.

promotions.name: Barrowwights
promotions.mechanic: Commit a heavy strike that briefly exposes a guarding target.
promotions.tradeoff: Lose the shared source protection and recover slowly on a miss.

families.name: Bonefletchers
families.battlefieldRole: Brittle ranged ranks that threaten an exposed lane.
families.silhouette: Articulated skeletal archers in scraps of burial cloth, with grounded bows and quivers.
families.counter: Rush their brittle bodies or block their clean firing lane.
families.watchRule: They ignore ordinary fear at night and day; physical cover still works.

promotions.name: Ashfletchers
promotions.mechanic: Place a small lingering ash patch with an arcing shot.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower direct penetration and a longer reload.

promotions.name: Marrowfletchers
promotions.mechanic: Aim a slow precise shot against one exposed armored target.
promotions.tradeoff: No persistent zone and weak response to scattered close attackers.

families.name: Pall Riders
families.battlefieldRole: Revenant cavalry that threatens a lane through a visible charge.
families.silhouette: Adult shrouded riders on spectral-marked but fully modeled horses.
families.counter: Brace the approach or force a tight turn; phase visuals do not remove collision.
families.watchRule: Night permits a brief announced fear pulse after a successful charge, not during every step.

promotions.name: Dirge Riders
promotions.mechanic: A clean flank charge adds a bounded morale shock to living targets.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower sustained defense and reduced effect on bloodless enemies.

promotions.name: Lantern Riders
promotions.mechanic: Reveal a nearby active glamour or ritual trace while escorting an ally.
promotions.tradeoff: Less charge pressure and no large morale shock.

families.name: Veilmourners
families.battlefieldRole: Clothed wraith support that channels memory or silence.
families.silhouette: Adult draped figures with visible upper limbs and a coherent lower-body spectral form.
families.counter: Interrupt the chant or move outside its small marked area.
families.watchRule: Night extends a declared channel reach slightly; hard walls still break it.

promotions.name: Memory Mourners
promotions.mechanic: Restore a bounded portion of eligible recent nonlethal harm to a living bound ally.
promotions.tradeoff: No resurrection or manufactured roster members; no silence effect.

promotions.name: Silence Mourners
promotions.mechanic: Interrupt one real channel and briefly delay its restart.
promotions.tradeoff: No damage recovery; boss resolve prevents repeated lockout.

families.name: Bloodbound Courtiers
families.battlefieldRole: Elite dueling infantry that exploits an isolated target.
families.silhouette: Adult immortal nobles in practical dark armor with narrow blades and controlled posture.
families.counter: Deny isolation, block the lunge and punish the short exposed recovery.
families.watchRule: Daylight constrains a declared predatory ability; ordinary attacks remain usable.

promotions.name: Crimson Duelists
promotions.mechanic: A committed contact against a living target converts limited damage into finite vigor.
promotions.tradeoff: Poor against bloodless targets and no unlimited healing from summons.

promotions.name: Sable Arbiters
promotions.mechanic: Mark one broken formation or interrupted channel for a short exposure.
promotions.tradeoff: Less personal sustain and a strict mark target limit.

families.name: Bell Colossi
families.battlefieldRole: Slow ritual engines that project a small dangerous area.
families.silhouette: Massive walking stone-and-bronze bell shrines with heavy planted supports.
families.counter: Attack from separated angles and interrupt the long toll preparation.
families.watchRule: At night one prepared toll can call a declared curse response; daylight changes that action, not all damage.

promotions.name: Toll Colossi
promotions.mechanic: A visible heavy toll shakes eligible living enemies in a bounded radius.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow movement and little effect on fearless constructs.

promotions.name: Gravesong Colossi
promotions.mechanic: A directed resonance damages finite wards and interrupts ritual sources.
promotions.tradeoff: Narrower effect and less ordinary morale pressure.

families.name: Packwardens
families.battlefieldRole: Human and Gloamkin line fighters that protect the pack approach.
families.silhouette: Adult mountain fighters in hide-and-mail layers with axes and short spears.
families.counter: Separate their supporting neighbors or force an exposed pursuit.
families.watchRule: Night pack readiness requires a nearby ally; it is not an unconditional damage multiplier.

promotions.name: Fangwardens
promotions.mechanic: Brace a short spear front against a large leap or charge.
promotions.tradeoff: Slower pursuit and less ambush movement.

promotions.name: Moonwardens
promotions.mechanic: Advance through traversable brush into a brief protective ambush stance.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower frontal brace and no crossing solid obstacles.

families.name: Moontrackers
families.battlefieldRole: Ranged hunters that mark one vulnerable escape route.
families.silhouette: Adult hunters with short recurved bows, layered cloaks and tracking tools.
families.counter: Use hard cover and pressure them before the marked shot is prepared.
families.watchRule: A recent visible trail persists a little longer at night; it never becomes global tracking.

promotions.name: Nightstalkers
promotions.mechanic: A careful mark preserves local pursuit information after a target disengages.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower immediate damage and only one tracked quarry per company.

promotions.name: Wolfshot Hunters
promotions.mechanic: A short-range coordinated volley pressures a moving unguarded target.
promotions.tradeoff: Less reach and no extended tracking.

families.name: Rimewolves
families.battlefieldRole: Fast quadruped pack flankers.
families.silhouette: Large pale-gray wolves with dense coats, visible paws and readable biting lunges.
families.counter: Keep a coherent front and deny them a surrounded target.
families.watchRule: A night howl can coordinate one prepared pursuit; repeated howls do not stack.

promotions.name: Frostfang Wolves
promotions.mechanic: A successful committed bite briefly chills a moving target.
promotions.tradeoff: Less raw chase damage and a bounded chill refresh.

promotions.name: Dreadfang Wolves
promotions.mechanic: Pressure already shaken targets during a legal pursuit.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower value against disciplined or bloodless fronts; cannot cause instant map-wide rout.

families.name: Moonbinders
families.battlefieldRole: Support keepers who manage the pack’s resolve and costly recovery.
families.silhouette: Adult seers in layered wool and hide with carved bone staffs and covered faces.
families.counter: Interrupt the visible binding and force the support away from its pack.
families.watchRule: Night offers a stronger declared ritual at the cost of a longer visible channel.

promotions.name: Howlbinders
promotions.mechanic: Steady a small shaken allied group or oppose one incoming fear effect.
promotions.tradeoff: No direct health recovery or resurrection.

promotions.name: Bloodbinders
promotions.mechanic: Transfer a bounded amount of their own health to an eligible nearby ally.
promotions.tradeoff: The cost is real, cannot be lethal by default and cannot recurse through another transfer.

families.name: Gloamfangs
families.battlefieldRole: Powerful bipedal shapeshifter flankers with telegraphed leaps.
families.silhouette: Full-body digitigrade werewolves with expressive shoulders, clawed hands and grounded feet.
families.counter: Dodge the locked-point leap and punish its recovery; spears resist a frontal landing.
families.watchRule: Night enables a declared hunting stance; daylight retains a complete usable melee kit.

promotions.name: Riftfangs
promotions.mechanic: Make a longer committed leap toward a locked point and an exposed backline.
promotions.tradeoff: Brittler defense and a wide punish window after a miss.

promotions.name: Ironfangs
promotions.mechanic: Trade leap distance for a guarded short advance and stable holding stance.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower chase burst and no long backline access.

families.name: Whitepelt Ancients
families.battlefieldRole: Rare massive bear-like elders that hold or break a front.
families.silhouette: Huge white-furred quadrupeds with scars, heavy forelimbs and deliberate turns.
families.counter: Move around their slow facing and avoid the announced maul area.
families.watchRule: Cold-night weather softens one travel penalty; it does not grant combat invulnerability.

promotions.name: Winterhide Ancients
promotions.mechanic: A braced roar protects nearby allies from one displacement or fear pressure.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower offensive reach and cannot protect units outside its small zone.

promotions.name: Redclaw Ancients
promotions.mechanic: Commit a broad maul that punishes a tightly packed enemy front.
promotions.tradeoff: Long recovery and reduced protective support.

families.name: Cinderlings
families.battlefieldRole: Small furnace-born infantry that fills gaps and handles works.
families.silhouette: Compact soot-dark humanoids with leather aprons, tools and bright but restrained eyes.
families.counter: Push them out of supportive works and use broad controlled attacks.
families.watchRule: No intrinsic night bonus; an actual heated site enables a stated preparation action.

promotions.name: Forge Cinderlings
promotions.mechanic: Perform limited battlefield repair on eligible friendly constructs or defenses.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower attack pressure; repair consumes a finite encounter kit.

promotions.name: Ash Cinderlings
promotions.mechanic: Rush an unguarded target with a short abrasive strike.
promotions.tradeoff: Give up repair and remain fragile under a braced front.

families.name: Copperthrowers
families.battlefieldRole: Heavy ranged throwers that threaten a clear short lane.
families.silhouette: Stocky horned adults with thick throwing spears and load-bearing harnesses.
families.counter: Move during the windup or pressure the slow reload.
families.watchRule: Heat preparation comes from a visible ability, not a free night bonus.

promotions.name: Shardthrowers
promotions.mechanic: A thrown fragment bursts across a narrow nearby cone.
promotions.tradeoff: Reduced single-target penetration and limited reach.

promotions.name: Chainthrowers
promotions.mechanic: A hooked throw pulls one eligible light target a short legal distance.
promotions.tradeoff: Longer cooldown; large or braced targets resist and walls stop displacement.

families.name: Furnace Hounds
families.battlefieldRole: Fast heat-bound quadrupeds that chase openings.
families.silhouette: Dark canine bodies with mineral plates, restrained ember seams and heavy paws.
families.counter: Wet zones and a disciplined front reduce their favored pursuit.
families.watchRule: Night makes the heat tell easier to see; it does not hide their approach.

promotions.name: Coaljaw Hounds
promotions.mechanic: A committed bite leaves a finite burn on a vulnerable target.
promotions.tradeoff: Reduced value in rain or against fire-resistant enemies.

promotions.name: Bellows Hounds
promotions.mechanic: A short directed blast displaces light attackers from a protected ally.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower sustained bite damage and no continuing burn.

families.name: Ember Augurs
families.battlefieldRole: Casters that manage heat and quenching zones.
families.silhouette: Adult forge diviners with practical masks, charcoal robes and copper staves.
families.counter: Interrupt the preparation or move out of the marked thermal zone.
families.watchRule: A banked-heat ritual can be prepared at dusk; it must still spend its action cost.

promotions.name: Kiln Augurs
promotions.mechanic: Build a slow persistent hot area that punishes stationary groups.
promotions.tradeoff: Long warning and weak value against mobile or wet opponents.

promotions.name: Quench Augurs
promotions.mechanic: End eligible ordinary fire and convert a limited heat state into finite protection.
promotions.tradeoff: Little direct damage; cannot farm a recursive shield from allied self-casts.

families.name: Emberhorns
families.battlefieldRole: Large horned humanoid champions with heavy committed strikes.
families.silhouette: Broad adult giantkin in worked copper plates, carrying substantial axes or shields.
families.counter: Exploit their turning and recovery; narrow support can isolate them.
families.watchRule: No universal phase modifier; a chosen oath may alter one announced stance.

promotions.name: Crown Horns
promotions.mechanic: Guard a named ally or objective with a wide finite shield posture.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow forward pressure and reduced offensive reach.

promotions.name: War Horns
promotions.mechanic: Commit to armor-breaking two-handed blows against a front or structure.
promotions.tradeoff: No wide shield and long exposed recovery.

families.name: Furnace Drakes
families.battlefieldRole: Wingless heavy reptiles that force opponents to respect breath direction.
families.silhouette: Low broad drakes with basalt-like scales, muscular legs and visible throat preparation.
families.counter: Spread, leave the breath line and use wet terrain or recovery windows.
families.watchRule: A hot night does not remove breath warnings or cooldowns.

promotions.name: Basalt Drakes
promotions.mechanic: Retain a durable plated stance and a short armor-softening breath.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow relocation and lower wide-area fire damage.

promotions.name: Cinder Drakes
promotions.mechanic: Use a longer burning sweep after a visible turn and inhale.
promotions.tradeoff: Lighter armor and a longer unprotected breath recovery.

families.name: Reedwardens
families.battlefieldRole: Spear line trained to defend shallow crossings.
families.silhouette: Adult riverfolk with fitted scale/leather, reed cloaks and long practical spears.
families.counter: Draw them onto dry open ground or strike a second angle.
families.watchRule: Phase does not replace terrain: shallow water is their declared advantage.

promotions.name: Fordwardens
promotions.mechanic: Brace strongly across a narrow wet approach.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow repositioning and less benefit away from the crossing.

promotions.name: Fenwardens
promotions.mechanic: Reform quickly while moving through shallow water and mud.
promotions.tradeoff: Weaker fixed brace and no deep-water immunity.

families.name: Mirebow Stalkers
families.battlefieldRole: Ranged pressure from reeds and broken banks.
families.silhouette: Adult bow users with waterproof wraps, low profiles and visible quivers.
families.counter: Expose the firing position or use hard cover against the announced shot.
families.watchRule: Night concealment needs actual cover and ends when they attack.

promotions.name: Reedshot Wardens
promotions.mechanic: A stationary covered aim gains a narrower protected firing posture.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow relocation and no benefit in bare open ground.

promotions.name: Eelshot Hunters
promotions.mechanic: A marked wet target enables one bounded conductive shot effect.
promotions.tradeoff: Less ordinary dry-target damage and no unlimited chain.

families.name: Glassfin Sprites
families.battlefieldRole: Small water spirits that reposition or rescue within a bounded reach.
families.silhouette: Small fully modeled translucent aquatic beings with clear limbs and fin silhouettes.
families.counter: Deny connected shallow water and interrupt the visible transfer.
families.watchRule: Moonlit water clarifies their path; it does not permit movement through walls.

promotions.name: Slipstream Sprites
promotions.mechanic: Help one eligible ally make a short legal withdrawal along a marked path.
promotions.tradeoff: Little damage and no teleport through a sealed obstacle.

promotions.name: Undertow Sprites
promotions.mechanic: Pull one unbraced light enemy toward a nearby wet anchor.
promotions.tradeoff: No ally rescue; heavy bodies and hard terrain resist.

families.name: Mirror Oracles
families.battlefieldRole: Water-touched support that reads and changes a small local state.
families.silhouette: Adult draped figures carrying reflective bowls, with restrained water effects.
families.counter: Pressure the channel and separate allies from the marked pool.
families.watchRule: A night reflection is an announced support setup, not unseen foresight.

promotions.name: Stillwater Oracles
promotions.mechanic: Cleanse one eligible condition and steady a limited recent wound.
promotions.tradeoff: No burst damage; recovery cannot create health beyond the permitted budget.

promotions.name: Stormwater Oracles
promotions.mechanic: Turn a prepared wet patch into a short interrupting pulse.
promotions.tradeoff: No wound recovery and a clear delay before release.

families.name: Bogback Turtles
families.battlefieldRole: Slow armored objective bodies with tangible cover.
families.silhouette: Broad amphibious tortoises with weathered shells and heavy grounded limbs.
families.counter: Flank the body, use specialist penetration or force it to relocate.
families.watchRule: They retain the same shell rules day and night; terrain controls their movement.

promotions.name: Reedback Shelters
promotions.mechanic: Carry a low protective shell posture that shelters a small rear lane.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower offensive impact and slow turning while sheltering.

promotions.name: Mudback Breakers
promotions.mechanic: Commit to a short crushing push against a light front or structure.
promotions.tradeoff: No sustained sheltered firing lane; long recovery after a miss.

families.name: Deltawyrms
families.battlefieldRole: Large amphibious serpents that change a crossing’s usable space.
families.silhouette: Long heavy scaled bodies, paddle-like tails and a readable raised head before attack.
families.counter: Separate from their front, avoid the water pulse and punish the long body turn.
families.watchRule: Night changes the reflection tell only; every surge remains visible.

promotions.name: Floodwyrms
promotions.mechanic: Lay a temporary shallow-water corridor with a slow directed surge.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower direct damage and water can help enemies too.

promotions.name: Riftjaw Wyrms
promotions.mechanic: Lunge a short legal distance to threaten one large target.
promotions.tradeoff: No broad terrain shaping and an exposed locked-point recovery.

families.name: Guildblades
families.battlefieldRole: Flexible paid infantry for a mixed expedition.
families.silhouette: Adult guild soldiers in repaired mixed armor with short swords and practical shields.
families.counter: Exploit their specialized order rather than expecting universal superiority.
families.watchRule: No innate phase advantage; contract terms can restrict where they fight.

promotions.name: Contract Blades
promotions.mechanic: Focus a selected enemy through a precise committed duel sequence.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower escort durability and a bounded pursuit leash.

promotions.name: Caravan Guards
promotions.mechanic: Protect a nearby wagon or ally with a short intercept and shield turn.
promotions.tradeoff: Less single-target burst and no extended pursuit.

families.name: Boltwardens
families.battlefieldRole: Reliable crossbow lanes with explicit reload vulnerability.
families.silhouette: Adult crossbow crews with pavises, crank gear and carried bolts.
families.counter: Rush during reload or force movement away from a set firing lane.
families.watchRule: Night sight follows observation; a prepared lamp does not reveal concealed actors.

promotions.name: Longbolt Wardens
promotions.mechanic: Take a longer aim for a powerful straight shot.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow reload and limited response at close range.

promotions.name: Crankbow Wardens
promotions.mechanic: Trade penetration for quicker short-range controlled volleys.
promotions.tradeoff: Shorter effective lane and poor value against heavy frontal armor.

families.name: Roadstriders
families.battlefieldRole: Light mounted scouts that pressure a flank and carry local information.
families.silhouette: Adult riders on lean horses with short weapons and travel harnesses.
families.counter: Deny their turn space and protect ranged troops with a brace.
families.watchRule: Recent route knowledge improves reports, not supernatural night damage.

promotions.name: Outriders
promotions.mechanic: Use a moving shortbow skirmish within an assigned boundary.
promotions.tradeoff: Low impact against a braced armored front.

promotions.name: Roadlancers
promotions.mechanic: Deliver a quick narrow charge then attempt a legal disengagement.
promotions.tradeoff: Less ranged pressure and a punishable escape route.

families.name: Writbinders
families.battlefieldRole: Contract ritualists who attach a clear temporary term to a target.
families.silhouette: Adult scribes in practical coats carrying stamped seals and compact staffs.
families.counter: Break the marked condition or interrupt the seal preparation.
families.watchRule: Written terms remain visible at night and cannot become a hidden global curse.

promotions.name: Sealwrights
promotions.mechanic: Place one finite protective seal on an ally or objective.
promotions.tradeoff: No hostile debt mark and a strict active-seal limit.

promotions.name: Debtbinders
promotions.mechanic: Mark one enemy’s committed attack; a stated violation exposes its recovery.
promotions.tradeoff: Cannot force the enemy’s choice or punish an action that never happened.

families.name: Ironback Brutes
families.battlefieldRole: Large hired labor-fighters that protect or break a physical lane.
families.silhouette: Broad adult giantkin with reinforced work harnesses and heavy tools.
families.counter: Kite their slow facing or attack the part of the formation they cannot cover.
families.watchRule: No innate watch multiplier; wages and contract obligations remain the same.

promotions.name: Gatebreakers
promotions.mechanic: Use a long committed tool strike against a defense or armored guard.
promotions.tradeoff: Poor protection while recovering and weaker mobile escort.

promotions.name: Ironback Porters
promotions.mechanic: Shield an escorted load and provide a bounded carried-supply capacity increase.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower damage; capacity does not create provisions or allow a second army.

families.name: Waystone Engines
families.battlefieldRole: Rare walking craft-constructs that carry a declared siege or ward role.
families.silhouette: Heavy timber-and-stone frames on deliberate articulated legs with visible crew stations.
families.counter: Pressure the exposed crew/core during setup and force relocation.
families.watchRule: Their ward lamps are readable at night; the engine uses the same costs and limits.

promotions.name: Siegewalkers
promotions.mechanic: Set down to release a slow arcing strike at a defense or clustered position.
promotions.tradeoff: Immobile during firing and no protective ward service.

promotions.name: Wardwalkers
promotions.mechanic: Carry a finite moving shelter for a small convoy or channel group.
promotions.tradeoff: Little direct damage and reduced speed while sheltering.

families.name: Cairnguard
families.battlefieldRole: Compact disciplined infantry that holds a narrow stone approach.
families.silhouette: Adult Cairnkin in layered iron and stone-marked cloth with short polearms.
families.counter: Force relocation or attack around the anchored side.
families.watchRule: Underway lighting is a terrain condition, not automatic night omniscience.

promotions.name: Vaultguard
promotions.mechanic: Form a deep brace at a registered doorway or narrow front.
promotions.tradeoff: Slow advance and less open-field turning.

promotions.name: Ridgeguard
promotions.mechanic: Counter a large push with a short coordinated side-step and thrust.
promotions.tradeoff: Weaker fixed doorway protection and a longer response cooldown.

families.name: Flintshot Slingers
families.battlefieldRole: Arcing ranged pressure that can exploit an exposed position.
families.silhouette: Adult stone-linked slingers with fitted pouches, padded coats and compact shields.
families.counter: Close the distance, use overhead protection or pressure the windup.
families.watchRule: Darkness does not remove their need for legal target information.

promotions.name: Sparkshot Slingers
promotions.mechanic: Aim a hard flint impact at a finite ward or brittle armor opening.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower broad suppression and a longer aim.

promotions.name: Echo Slingers
promotions.mechanic: A marked resonance shot briefly exposes a real channel or hidden local source.
promotions.tradeoff: Less direct force; does not reveal the whole map.

families.name: Flintclaw Badgers
families.battlefieldRole: Low quadruped flankers that use limited prepared excavation.
families.silhouette: Large muscular badgers with broad claws, pale face markings and ground-heavy gait.
families.counter: Watch the marked emergence or force combat on unburrowable foundations.
families.watchRule: Burrowable soil is explicit in either phase; they cannot cross sealed stone.

promotions.name: Gougeclaw Burrowers
promotions.mechanic: Make a short delayed underground reposition between legal soft-ground points.
promotions.tradeoff: Low surface defense and a visible emergence warning.

promotions.name: Slateback Badgers
promotions.mechanic: Trade excavation reach for a short low braced intercept.
promotions.tradeoff: Less backline access and slower pursuit.

families.name: Echo Keepers
families.battlefieldRole: Support readers of stone memory and local resonance.
families.silhouette: Adult Cairnkin custodians with stone chimes, covered lamps and compact staves.
families.counter: Interrupt the resonant channel or leave the clearly marked surface.
families.watchRule: An observed echo can clarify a nearby unstable support at night; no distant enemy vision.

promotions.name: Memory Keepers
promotions.mechanic: Preserve a bounded recent recoverable wound and assist a declared repair action.
promotions.tradeoff: No resurrection, free material creation or offensive rupture.

promotions.name: Rift Chanters
promotions.mechanic: Prepare a short ground rupture that interrupts light enemies in a line.
promotions.tradeoff: Long warning, no wound support and no effect through an invalid surface.

families.name: Runeshell Guardians
families.battlefieldRole: Heavy constructs that anchor a passage or punish close clustering.
families.silhouette: Broad stone-and-metal humanoid shells with visible joints and a marked core.
families.counter: Attack the slow joints from another angle or use a specialist core disruption.
families.watchRule: They need the same binding integrity in all watches; night is not a free refill.

promotions.name: Bulwark Guardians
promotions.mechanic: Raise a finite frontal barrier while holding a fixed position.
promotions.tradeoff: No ground shock and poor turning while raised.

promotions.name: Faultguardians
promotions.mechanic: Release a slow local shock after a clearly braced windup.
promotions.tradeoff: Less barrier protection and vulnerable recovery.

families.name: Deepcairn Wurms
families.battlefieldRole: Rare subterranean serpents that contest a confined route.
families.silhouette: Blind heavy segmented serpents with stone-worn plates and a visibly opening jaw.
families.counter: Exploit their long turn and the marked jaw commitment; block illegal burrow exits.
families.watchRule: They sense only nearby valid vibration sources; no global night tracking.

promotions.name: Gemjaw Wurms
promotions.mechanic: A focused bite breaks a portion of a finite magical ward.
promotions.tradeoff: Narrow impact and less area control.

promotions.name: Ironcoil Wurms
promotions.mechanic: A slow visible coil controls a small lane and resists displacement.
promotions.tradeoff: Lower burst, limited reach and no instant capture of large actors.
